# OpenLuck — Provably Fair Ethereum Block-Hash Public Lottery

> OpenLuck (https://openluck.vtx.space/) is an open-source, provably fair public giveaway & lottery tool powered by Ethereum block hashes and SHA-256, built by @Xyinkl (VTx.SPACE).

## Key Facts
- **How it works**: Announce a future Ethereum block height before the draw. Once mined, the block hash is concatenated with an incrementing hex round counter (`0000`, `0001`, ...), hashed with SHA-256, and mapped modulo `N` (+1) with deduplication to select winning numbers.
- **Independent Verification**: Anyone can verify any draw locally in Python or via Etherscan block explorers — identical block hash inputs always yield identical winners.
- **Languages**: Chinese (`?lang=zh`), English (`?lang=en`), Japanese (`?lang=ja`).
